summary:
Last week the site assistant went fully live on phillipsben.com — knowledge pack, streaming chat overlay, adversarial hardening, and the flagship write-up all shipped. This week shifted to post-launch cleanup and site polish.

The hero image pipeline landed: generated art for all project pages, plumbed through a build-time invariant guard that fails the build if a project is missing art. The `/now` page was restructured as a long-form field note with an archive. The hobbies section got nine palette-duotoned photo slots wired up. Home copy got another tightening pass — identity-line kicker, footer updated to reflect human + agent authorship, booking CTAs added throughout.

On the infrastructure side, Hermes's daily dashboard cron has been running stably, Spotify credentials refreshed and persisted, and the Currently panel on the home page now mirrors the dashboard as a single source of truth. (snapshot stale, last sync unknown)

highlights.oneLiner: Hero image pipeline live: generated art for all project pages, build-time invariant guard, and heroes:check helper added.
/now restructured as a long-form field note with archive; hobbies gallery wired with 9 duotone photo slots.
Daily dashboard cron running stably; Spotify credentials refreshed and persisted.
